We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Real Estate Investment Operations Manager to execute the day-to-day operations of our BRRRR (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat) real estate investment strategy.



This individual will not make investment decisions but will manage nearly every operational component of the acquisition, renovation, leasing, refinancing, and ongoing coordination process.



The ideal candidate loves systems, checklists, project management, spreadsheets, communication, and solving problems. Their success will allow the investor to focus on strategy and capital allocation rather than administrative work.



Primary Responsibilities

1. Deal Sourcing & Market Research

Search the MLS, Zillow, Redfin, 
, wholesalers, auctions, and off-market opportunities.

Research neighborhoods based on investment criteria.

Analyze comparable sales (ARVs).

Research rental comparables.

Calculate estimated cash flow.

Build investment spreadsheets.

Identify properties that meet our BRRRR criteria.

Present qualified opportunities for review.

Once a property is selected:

Coordinate with our Realtor.

Coordinate inspections.

Obtain repair estimates.

Schedule contractor walkthroughs.

Collect documentation.

Organize purchase paperwork.

Track deadlines.

Maintain due diligence checklist.

Tracking budgets.

Following up with contractors.

Requesting progress photos/videos.

Managing change orders.

Verifying completed work.

Scheduling inspections.

Updating project dashboards.

Contractors

Handymen

Plumbers

HVAC companies

Roofing companies

Inspectors

Attorneys

Insurance agents

Lenders

Property managers

Title companies

Maintain a preferred vendor database.



5. Leasing Coordination

Work with the property manager to:

Ensure property is rent-ready.

Schedule photography.

Coordinate listings.

Verify rental pricing.

Track applications.

Coordinate lease execution.

Confirm move-in dates.



6. Refinance Coordination

Prepare refinance packages including:

Updated financials.

Rehab costs.

Before/after photos.

Property documentation.

Income statements.

Rent rolls.

Insurance documents.

Coordinate directly with lender.



7. Property Management Oversight

Coordinate with our property manager by:

Reviewing monthly reports.

Tracking occupancy.

Following up on maintenance.

Monitoring expenses.

Reviewing tenant issues.

Ensuring timely communication.

Escalating major issues.



8. Financial Tracking

Closing costs

Rehab budget

Actual rehab costs

Carrying costs

Interest expenses

Rental income

Cash flow

ROI

Equity

Loan balances

BRRRR performance metrics



9. Systems & Documentation

Maintain:

Google Drive organization

Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Contractor database

Property files

Investment dashboard

Checklists

Calendars

Project timelines



10. Weekly Reporting

Prepare weekly reports including:

Current acquisitions

Rehab status

Budget updates

Upcoming deadlines

Risks

Vendor issues

Cash flow summary

Recommended priorities



Required Skills

Exceptional organizational ability

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong project management skills

Advanced Google Sheets/Excel

Ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously

Excellent follow-up skills

High attention to detail

Strong communication skills

Comfortable working independently

Ability to create and improve systems



Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting U.S. real estate investors

Knowledge of the BRRRR investing model

Familiarity with property management software

Experience coordinating contractors

Basic understanding of mortgages and refinancing

Experience with project management software such as Asana, 
, ClickUp, or Trello



Software You'll Use

Google Workspace

Microsoft Excel

Google Sheets

Asana or ClickUp

Slack

Zoom

DocuSign

Dropbox or Google Drive

Zillow

Redfin



MLS (if access is provided)

Rentometer (preferred)

ChatGPT



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Number of qualified deals sourced per week

Time from accepted offer to closing

Rehab completed on time

Rehab completed within budget

Days to rent property

Refinance completed on schedule

Vendor response times

Accuracy of financial tracking

Weekly reporting completed on time

System improvements implemented



What Success Looks Like

Within six months, the Real Estate Investment Operations Manager will have built repeatable systems that allow us to purchase, renovate, rent, refinance, and stabilize investment properties with minimal involvement from the owner. The goal is to reduce the owner's operational workload to strategic decision-making while ensuring each BRRRR project moves efficiently from acquisition through refinancing.



How to Apply



If you're an exceptional operations professional who thrives on organization, ownership, and execution, we'd love to hear from you.



This role is part of a mission-driven real estate investment business that generates resources to support a global Christian evangelization ministry. Because of this, we are seeking a committed Christian whose faith is reflected in their character, integrity, and stewardship.



To be considered, please submit the following in English:



1. Resume highlighting your relevant experience in real estate operations, project management, investment coordination, property management, or similar operational leadership roles.

2. Cover Letter explaining your relevant experience, why you're interested in this role, and how your Christian faith influences your work.

3. Video Introduction (Maximum of 4 Minutes) introducing yourself, highlighting your relevant experience, and sharing why you'd like to join our team and how your faith has shaped your professional life.



We look forward to learning how your experience and values can contribute to both our business and our mission

title: Operations Manager
description:
We're a digital media company running a portfolio of media channels. A remote team, content pipelines, and ongoing correspondence with US agencies that supply the source material our content is built on. The content is high-production, the operation is scaling fast, and the team is growing to 30+ VAs over the next few months.

We're looking for an operations right-hand to help run it. This is not a task-VA role. You'll be the layer between the founder and the team, the person things route through, the person who makes the calls that don't need to reach the founder's desk.

This is a challenge role. If you want a comfortable job, don’t apply.



If you're an experienced operations manager or senior executive VA who has actually managed teams and wants a real ownership seat in a scaling company, this is the right fit.



What the job is:

The core of the role, and most of your week, is running the team of VAs who handle our ongoing communication with US agencies. You keep them on track, you're their first point of contact, and you make sure the correspondence keeps moving without the founder in the loop.

- Team coordination: leading the VAs, keeping them on track, being their point of contact, escalating to the founder only what genuinely needs it

- Communication: handling the correspondence that requires real judgment yourself, in clean professional English, without every message checked first

- Systems: writing, recording, and maintaining SOPs so the team runs on process.

- Growth: this role grows with the team. 30+ VAs within a few months.



Who this is for:

- Real experience as an operations manager. This is a step up, not a first management job.

- You make decisions and hold them. You know what to handle yourself and what to escalate.

- You write SOPs other people can execute without asking you follow-up questions.

- You can lead and coordinate other tea
mbers, not just take orders.

Participate in bid strategy meetings and contribute to the development of winning tender strategies.

Prepare and complete community benefit and social value submissions where required.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Demonstrable experience producing high-quality tender submissions.

title: experienced Sharetribe developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Sharetribe developer to help build a two-sided marketplace for churches and traveling preachers/evangelists.



The platform will allow preachers to create profiles, upload their travel/preaching schedule, and show where they will be available. Churches will be able to create accounts, search by city or map, see which preachers will be near their area, and request to connect with them.



The developer must be familiar with Sharetribe and marketplace builds.



Main features needed:



* Preacher profiles with bio, photos, ministry focus, location, videos, and contact/request options

* Church accounts with location, church info, and alert preferences

* Preachers must be able to add itinerary/schedule entries by city, date range, and availability

* Churches must be able to search by city, radius, map, date, language, and other filters

* Map-based search showing preachers near a selected area

* Request/contact system between churches and preachers

* Paid access for preachers and churches

* Stripe subscription/payment setup

* Admin dashboard to approve users, manage listings, and review activity

* Automatic
 notifications when a preacher adds an itinerary near a church’s area

* Zapier, Make, or custom automation experience is preferred

* Experience with location/radius logic is strongly preferred



The most important part of this project is the schedule and location matching.



Example: if a preacher adds that they will be in Houston, TX from August 10–14, the system should be able to notify churches within 100 miles of Houston.



We are open to using Sharetribe as the main platform and adding outside tools like Zapier, Make, Supabase, Airtable, Resend, Stripe, Mapbox, or Google Maps if needed.



Please only apply if you have experience building in Sharetribe or similar marketplace platforms. Include examples of Sharetribe marketplaces or two-sided marketplaces you have built.

title: Inbox Manager & Email VA
description:
About the role



We run a UK-based course creation and marketing agency for coaches and consultants. Our outreach brings in a steady flow of warm replies from interested leads every day, and we need one dependable person to own that inbox. Your job is to reply fast, keep conversations moving, and turn interest into booked calls on our sales team's calendar.



This is a non-voice role. There is no cold calling and no phone work of any kind. Everything happens over
.



What you'll do





Own a busy shared inbox and reply to incoming lead messages within minutes

Work with our AI drafting system. It writes a first draft the 
nt a reply lands, you review it, improve it, and send. When the draft misses the mark, you write a better one. The tool makes you faster. Your judgment makes it convert.



Guide interested leads to book a call through our scheduling link, and confirm the booking



Qualify each lead against a simple checklist before booking



Keep our CRM (GHL) clean and current



Use quiet periods for supporting tasks such as data entry, list hygiene, and logging results from our
 tests





How we measure the role



One number matters most: how quickly leads get a reply. Our system produces an automated daily report of reply times, and the standard is a median reply under 3 minutes during your shift. It is tracked by software, not by someone looking over your shoulder. Hit the standard, book the calls that come in, and you are doing the job well.



This role is for you if



Your written English is excellent. Clear, natural, warm, and correct. This is the core skill, and the whole role runs on it.

You are genuinely fast. You can read a reply, judge it, adjust a draft, and send within a couple of minutes, over and over, all shift.

You have experience managing a lead inbox, setting appointments by
, or handling
-based customer support

You are detail-oriented with CRM records and can follow a process exactly

You have fast, reliable internet plus a backup connection, and a plan for power outages. Our promise to leads is a fast reply, so this genuinely matters on a night shift.

You want a stable, long-term role with steady pay, not a short gig





Hours



Full-time, 10 hours a day, Monday to Friday.



12:00 noon to 10:00pm UK time, which is 7:00pm to 5:00am Philippine time (8:00pm to 6:00am when UK clocks change in winter). This is an evening-to-early-morning shift, so please only apply if these hours genuinely work for you long term.



Compensation



$1,000 USD per month, flat and guaranteed

Paid reliably, on time, every month

Annual review with room to grow as the company grows





No commission games and no unpredictable pay. You know exactly what you earn.



Why this seat is worth taking



Non-voice, with no cold calls ever

Warm leads only. Every person you speak to has already replied and shown interest.

AI tools that do the heavy drafting so you can focus on judgment and speed

One clear, fairly measured performance standard instead of micromanagement

Stable monthly pay from a team that keeps its people long term





How to apply



Please read carefully. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.





Complete this short written role-play. A lead has replied to our outreach with: "This looks interesting but I'm slammed this month. Maybe circle back later?" Write the exact
 reply you would send to keep this lead moving toward a booked call. Paste your reply at the top of your application.



Record a short Loom video, 1 to 2 minutes. Say the word "pumpkin" as the very first word of your video, then introduce yourself and tell us about your relevant experience. This is a non-voice role, so we are not judging your accent. We just want to meet you. Include the link in your application.



Tell us your internet speed, your backup internet option, and your plan if the power goes out during a shift.

Use this exact subject line: Fast Inbox - [Your First Name]





We read every application that follows these three steps.

title: Media Buyer / Local Lead Gen Paid Ads Specialist (Meta and Google)
description:
Want to run local lead gen ads that actually turn into booked appointments, sales, and real business growth?



At Mill Creek Marketing, we help outdoor living contractors stay booked with profitable projects through trust-first marketing and sales systems. We are looking for a sharp, experienced, detail-oriented Media Buyer / Paid Ads Specialist to own paid campaign performance for our client accounts. 



This is not a “launch generic ads and hope for the best” role. This is also not a beginner's role. We're looking for a seasoned expert. 



You’ll be responsible for building, managing, optimizing, and improving paid campaigns that generate qualified leads, booked appointments, and customer acquisition at numbers that make sense for our contractor clients. 



If you are the kind of person who loves knowing your numbers, testing smart ideas, improving performance, and owning outcomes, then this could be a great fit.



** Please see HOW TO APPLY at the bottom of this job description before applying; only those who follow our application instructions at the bottom of this description will be considered ** 



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:



You’ll get to step into a company with proven offers, playbooks, templates, tracking systems, and client results already in place — while still having room to bring your own expertise to the table.



You will have:

— $36k/year base salary, depending on experience

— Performance bonus opportunity 

— Remote work, US-based, with CST operating hours

— Full-time role, 35–40 hours per week

— Direct access to leadership

— Growth opportunities as the company scales

— A proven playbook library, templates, and campaign frameworks

— Access to trainings, courses, and weekly live group support/Q&A with industry leaders

— A team that values ownership, excellence, clear communication, and getting better every day 

— This role will start as a 1099 contractor.

— No health benefits are offered at this time.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



You’ll own the day-to-day performance of paid campaigns for outdoor living contractor clients.



That includes:



— Building, launching, and managing trust-first Meta and Google campaigns

— Structuring campaigns, ad sets, and ads for clean testing and easy optimization

— Monitoring performance daily

— Optimizing for CPL, cost per booked appointment, lead quality, and CAC

— Turning off losers and scaling winners based on clear rules

— Collaborating with our team on offers, angles, and creatives

— Preparing simple weekly reports with spend, leads, CPL, CPBA, CAC, and next steps

— Keeping ad accounts clean, organized, and easy to understand

— Working with our tech specialist and fulfillment support to make sure tracking and attribution are accurate



You’ll also help write trust-first, outcome-oriented copy for:

- Paid ad campaigns

- Database reactivation campaigns (SMS and
) 

- SMS and
 nurture sequences



We want someone who can follow our proven processes, but also bring their own expertise and ideas that make our system stronger.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 



You are winning in this role when:



— Portfolio-level CPL is at or below target

— Campaigns are optimized for booked appointments and CAC, not just cheap leads

— Clients have consistent, predictable, qualified lead flow

— Ad accounts are clean and not over-fragmented

— You know your numbers, your tests, and your next moves at all times 

— You communicate clearly and proactively

— You flag issues early and bring proposed solutions

— You take ownership of results, not just tasks



This Role Is For You If…



You:



— Have 2+ years of proven paid ads experience for local lead generation

— Have experience with residential contractors or home service businesses (outdoor living preferably — pool builders, hardscapers, landscapers, deck builders, etc) 

— Are confident inside Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

— Understand CPL, CPBA, CAC, attribution, and lead quality

— Make decisions from data, not guesswork

— Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

— Have native-level written English

— Can write direct response, trust-building copy 

— Handle feedback well and actively seek it out

— Enjoy working with a team

— Are organized, proactive, and deadline-driven

— Want to grow into more ownership as the company grows



This Role Is Not For You If…



You:



— Have only run ecom or info product ads and do not understand local lead gen

— Need constant hand-holding

— Dislike feedback

— Struggle with deadlines

— Work slowly or wait to be told what to do

— Struggle to keep details organized 

— Do not enjoy or have proven experience writing copy

— Only want to “manage ads” without owning business outcomes



Tools You’ll Use



— Meta Ads Manager

— Google Ads

— GoHighLevel

— Cometly

— Slack

—
 Messenger

— ClickUp

— Google Drive

— Foreplay Winning Ad Workflow app



What We’ll Expect In The First 90 Days



We’ll train you on our contractor avatars, offers, campaign structure, internal systems, reporting, and performance standards.

Within 90 days, you should be confidently managing a pod of accounts, hitting CPL and CPBA targets, and bringing clear weekly recommendations for tests, optimizations, and next steps.



HOW TO APPLY



— Send us a message with the subject line: Ricky Bobby Media Buyer

— Include your resume and any relevant screenshots, case studies, or portfolio links.

— Then record a 3–5 minute personalized (not generic or evergreen) Loom video where you:



-Introduce yourself and your background

-Explain your experience with residential contractors or local lead gen companies 

-Walk through 1–2 ad case studies, showing how you improved CPL and drove results

-Tell us why you believe you are the perfect fit for this particular role



About Mill Creek Marketing



Mill Creek Marketing helps great outdoor living companies stay booked with profitable projects by building simple, trust-first marketing and sales systems that free founders to earn more, grow their team, and enjoy their family.

We primarily serve residential contractors in outdoor living niches like decks, patios, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, landscaping, hardscaping, lighting, fencing, and pools.



Our Core Values



- Eagles Only — We are a company for people who hold themselves to an unusually high standard of ownership, excellence, and follow-through.

- Chop Wood, Carry Water — We do the right work, the right way, for a long time, instead of chasing hacks, moods, or shiny objects.

- Humble & Feedback-First — We care more about getting better than looking good, so we seek and give direct, constructive feedback without ego or tearing down.

- Truth Over Drama — We make decisions based on what’s real — data, facts, and commitments — not stories, excuses, or comfort.

- We Get To Do This — We work from gratitude and rest, not anxiety and striving, remembering that this work is a choice and a privilege.



Our Results



We have 22 five-star Google reviews and 10+ client success interviews.



Our Team



Savannah — Founder & CEO

Rex — Head of Client Strategy

Angel — Client Delivery & Success Manager

David — Sales Development Representative

Ricky — Technical Specialist

Anthony — Creative Specialist

Mary — Fulfillment & Operational Support

title: Video Editor / Content Creator
description:
About the Role



I'm a fractional CFO who works with $5-10M e-commerce brands. I'm growing my business through two content channels: paid video ads on Meta, and a podcast. I need a sharp video editor who stays on top of what's working in short-form content and brings their own creative eye to this - not just someone who cuts footage and exports files.



I handle the strategy, the scripting, and I'm on camera. But I want someone who watches what's performing, has opinions on creative angles, and will occasionally say "hey, have you thought about trying this?" 



If you pitch an idea and I like it, I'll film it. We'll test it together. Generating results from your ideas will have a very positive impact on your longer term prospects :)



This starts part-time. If you're good and the work grows, so does the engagement.



What You'll Be Working On



Paid Ad Creatives (priority)

- Edit raw video footage into polished short-form ads for Meta

- Add captions/subtitles (accurate, well-formatted)

- Organize and manage video assets — naming, versioning, exporting in the right formats

- Upload and organize creative in Meta Ads Manager

- Iterate quickly on creative variants based on performance data and feedback

- Proactively suggest new formats, hooks, or angles worth testing



Podcast Clips

- Cut short-form clips (30-90 seconds) from full podcast episodes

- Identify the most compelling 
nts — the clips that will stop someone mid-scroll

- Make them visually engaging: dynamic cuts, captions, frame changes. Not a static talking head with a logo.

- Format for LinkedIn and potentially other platforms



What I'm Looking For

- Strong video editing skills — my audience is professional/B2B, so the output needs to look sharp and credible, not like a lifestyle brand

- Someone who follows what's performing in short-form content and can translate those trends into actionable ideas for a thought leadership context

- Fast turnaround - I'm building a feedback loop where I test creative quickly. Speed matters.

- A creative opinion. I don't want someone who just waits for instructions. If you see something that could be better, say so.

- Detail-oriented with asset management - I don't want to chase you for files or explain naming conventions twice

- Comfortable with iteration - some things will work, some won't. That's the job.

- Nice to have: Experience editing content for consultants, coaches, or B2B service businesses. You'll understand the tone I'm going for without a lot of hand-holding.



The Details

- Part-time to start (~10-20 hours/week depending on volume)

- Remote, async-friendly - I don't need you in a specific timezone, just responsive and reliable

- Applications without a portfolio or examples of relevant work will not be considered



To Apply



Send me:

- Two or three examples of video content you've edited — short-form ads or clips preferred

- A short note (3-5 sentences) on your process: what tools you use, how you stay current on what's working in short-form content, and one format or trend you think is underused right now



The last question is important. I want to see how you think, not just what you can do.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeping Administrative Assistant
description:
Hello Possible Candidate; 



I am a Canadian bookkeeping business owner named Alice Wynter looking for a reliable, detail-oriented part-time Bookkeeping Administrative Assistant based in the Philippines.   



This is a remote, behind-the-scenes role supporting our internal bookkeeping team. There will be NO client contact.



The role will start at approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the possibility of growing to approximately 20 hours per week over time as the business grows.   



Please read this entire job posting carefully.   Applicants that respond with interest who do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Starting Rate: CAD $6.00 per hour

Possible Future Rate: CAD $7.00–$8.00 per hour after reliability, accuracy, communication, and ability to manage simple files are proven over time.    

Location: Remote, Virtual, Philippines

Schedule: Part-time, with availability during agreed Philippine hours (and at times Canadian time zone - Eastern Standard Time - Toronto, Ontario - Canada).  Working hours will vary and are not limited to a specific schedule.  You must be ok with this.   This will give you the opportunity to have a flexible schedule.   Your working hours however, must align with our Senior Bookkeeper's schedule, who is also in the Philippines. 





This is an independent contractor position, not an employee position.



The successful candidate will invoice me weekly on Fridays for hours worked.  Invoices must be in Canadian dollars and must include the hours worked for the week.   We also use a time tracker, which the contractor will be responsible for completing accurately.   Honest and accurate time tracking is very important.



About the Role



You will be assisting with bookkeeping related administrative tasks and supporting our Senior Bookkeeper as well as being in contact with me the owner from time to time. 



Tasks may include:



converting PDF bank or credit card statements to CSV files

organizing documents in Google Drive

renaming and filing receipts, statements, and reports

updating internal tracking spreadsheets

checking for missing documents

assisting with QuickBooks Online administrative work

helping prepare bookkeeping files for review

following written procedures and checklists



The successful candidate will also eventually manage approximately 3–4 simple client bookkeeping files independently, after training and review. These will be straightforward files and will help you stay familiar with our bookkeeping system, QuickBooks Online, and our internal workflow.



Even when managing simple client files, this remains a non-client-facing role. You will not be communicating directly with clients in any way. 



This role requires care, accuracy, and critical thinking. You must be able to work independently, think through small to medium problems, and ask clear questions when help is needed.



Requirements



The right person must be:



1. Reliable and consistent.   This is paramount.  If you have something in your life that could hinder reliability and consistency, please do not apply. 

2. Detail-oriented and accurate

3. A strong communicator

4. Comfortable with repetitive administrative work

5. Able to think critically and solve small to medium problems

6. Comfortable working independently with minimal direction

7. Honest with time tracking

8. Very good with Google Drive, Google Sheets, Gmail, and online systems

9. Able to follow written instructions carefully

10. Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

11. Respectful of confidential client information

12.  Truly interested in steady, long-term part-time work 



QuickBooks Online experience is strongly preferred. You do not need to be an expert, but you must be comfortable working inside QuickBooks Online at some level and willing to learn our specific workflow.



Communication Expectations



Reliability and communication are extremely important in this role.   Again, if you feel that you may have some matter in your life that could hinder you from being reliable, or if your communication skills are not stellar, please do not apply. 



We use WhatsApp and
 for communication.



During agreed working hours, you must be able to reply within approximately 1 hour. Outside of working hours, you should reply within 1 day.



You must also have:



1. Reliable and steady internet suitable for QuickBooks Online  (minimum speed of 3 mbps or higher)

2. A laptop or desktop computer

3. A proper workspace (with little distraction) and good privacy

4. very good written English



Confidentiality



This role involves access to bookkeeping and client-related information, so confidentiality is very important.



You must be willing to:



1. Work inside our Google Workspace system

2. Keep all client information confidential

3. Never share client information with anyone

4. Never download or keep client files unless instructed

5. Delete any downloaded files immediately after the task is complete

6. Use strong passwords and two-factor authentication where required



Hiring Process



Selected applicants will be invited to a short 15-minute initial interview with the owner Alice and our Senior Bookkeeper. 



After interviews, approximately 4–5 candidates may be invited to complete a paid test/trial period. The test/trial period will be paid at CAD $6.00 per hour and will take approximately 2 hours to complete. 



The purpose of the test/trial period is to assess accuracy, communication, reliability, ability to follow instructions, critical thinking, QuickBooks Online comfort, and fit with our bookkeeping workflow.



After the test/trial period, one successful candidate will be selected for the ongoing role. 



How to Apply



Please read this section carefully.   Applicants that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.





NOTE:  Follow these instructions if you would like to apply for this position:



At the top of your reply, please write this exact sentence:



I understand this role starts at approximately 5–10 hours per week at CAD $6.00 per hour, with possible growth over time. I also understand this is an independent contractor role, paid weekly on Fridays by invoice.



Then answer the four questions below in your own words.



Please do not use AI to write your answers. I am not looking for perfect or polished answers. I am looking for honest, thoughtful answers that show how you think, communicate, and solve problems. Generic answers like “I am hardworking, detail-oriented, and a fast learner” will not help your application.



This role starts slowly, around 5–10 hours per week, but will grow over time. 



Question #1:  Why does this role fit your life right now, and what would make you stay with a part-time role long-term?



Question #2:  Tell me about a real time when you had to do detailed or repetitive work and stay accurate. What was the work, and how did you make sure you did not miss anything?



Question #3:  Imagine you are converting a PDF bank statement to a CSV file. After converting it, something looks wrong.  Maybe the dates are messy, columns are not lining up, or the totals do not seem right. What would you do before asking for help?



Question #4:  Reliability and communication are extremely important in this role. If you had an internet issue, emergency, or personal situation that affected your work, exactly how would you handle it?



Please do not send a generic application. I am looking for someone careful, honest, reliable, and willing to grow with the business over time.   



Thank you for your time and consideration in applying for this position!  



Alice Wynter (owner)

Time-Saving Bookkeeping

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing e-commerce business specializing in online arbitrage — sourcing products from eBay and reselling them on Amazon for a profit. We operate with a fully remote team, clearly documented systems, and a results-driven approach to building a scalable sourcing operation. We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who knows how to find value, move quickly, and work independently within a structured process.



The Role

You will be responsible for sourcing profitable product leads from eBay and evaluating them for resale on Amazon. This includes working through a provided product list, reaching out to eBay sellers to gather additional information, and negotiating pricing down to our target buy price. You will also be expected to independently aggregate and validate new product leads on an ongoing basis.



Your Responsibilities

Research and evaluate eBay listings for Amazon resale potential

Contact eBay sellers to gather product details and negotiate pricing to target buy prices

Aggregate and submit new product leads using our internal tracking system

Validate leads against profitability thresholds using tools such as Keepa and SellerAmp

Maintain accurate records in Google Sheets throughout the sourcing process



Requirements

Fluent English — both written and spoken

Reliable computer, webcam, microphone, and stable internet connection

1+ year of experience as a Virtual Assistant

1+ year of hands-on Keepa experience (ability to read BSR history, price trends, and offer count changes)

Experience with SellerAmp (SAS) for profitability analysis

Solid understanding of ROI, profit margin, and Amazon sales rank

Online arbitrage sourcing experience — eBay sourcing experience is a strong plus

Comfortable working within Google Drive, Sheets, and Docs

Available for 40 hours per week



What We Provide

Full video training for every task in the role

Written SOPs with step-by-step instructions for each process

Access to required software and accounts (including sourcing tools)

Flexible scheduling — we will work with your availability to set a consistent calendar



Compensation:



5 USD per hour and additional bonuses for meeting spend goals.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, you must answer all of the following questions in order within your application. Incomplete responses will not be reviewed.



What experience do you have with the eBay marketplace? Be specific about how you have used it in a professional or sourcing context.



What tools have you used for Amazon product research (e.g., Keepa, SellerAmp, Tactical Arbitrage, RevSeller)? For each tool, explain in depth how you used it and what you were evaluating.



Walk me through your exact process for determining whether a product is profitable. Include every cost you factor in.

Are you familiar with the eBay-to-Amazon reselling model? Walk me through how you understand the process from start to finish.



How do you verify that an eBay listing and an Amazon listing are for the exact same product? What steps do you take to confirm a correct match?



What is your favorite animal? Put the name of your favorite animal as the subject line of the entire job offer response. 



How many product leads are you realistically able to research and evaluate per day? Describe what your daily sourcing workflow looks like.



Please attach a link to your resume. Make sure the link is publicly accessible before submitting.



What is the earliest date you would be able to start?

operations run smoothly. This role is the foundation of a growing team, and we expect the right person to

eventually lead it.

• Month 6+: Transition into a team management role as the business and team expand.

• Products are prepared by management in a Google Sheet. You receive access and begin the listing

process.

here.

• Basic creatives are produced to visually support the advertising campaigns that run alongside the

products.

• Once products are ready, you inform management so the advertising process can begin.

• When the store is live, you manage incoming customer
s and handle communications via a

shared WhatsApp group that includes management, the supplier, and relevant account managers.

new templates where none exist yet.



Core Responsibilities



• Customer service: managing inbound
s, handling inquiries and disputes professionally

• Basic creative production: creating visual assets to support advertising campaigns

• Order and supply chain management: tracking orders, flagging issues, coordinating with suppliers

• Supplier communication: direct contact with suppliers and account managers in English via

WhatsApp

• Process building: proactively setting up templates and SOPs where none exist yet



What We Are Looking For



• Prior experience in customer service and/or product listing — e-commerce background preferred

• Strong written communication in English — supplier contact requires clarity and professionalism

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously without losing overview

title: RMM & MSP Solutions Engineer

You will be the primary owner of NinjaRMM and IMMYbot, driving adoption, scripting automation, and continuous improvement across our managed client base. Where your skillset adds value, you will also roll up your sleeves to assist the Technical Services team with client onboarding, escalations, and projects.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Marketing Operations Lead
description:
Intellectual Strategies is a U.S.-based fractional legal team helping innovators and scaling CEOs align legal and business strategy. Our founder, Jeff Holman, also hosts The Breakout CEO podcast, featuring candid conversations with growth-stage leaders across SaaS, eCommerce, and tech.



We're a law firm, but we don't operate like a normal law firm. We have a podcast focused on our clients and potential clients. We have a boring law firm and a separate podcast blog. We need to launch our newsletter (or maybe newsletters. We have platforms for podcast guest management and, for the law firm, client onboarding and project management. Our website was refreshed in 2025, but needs a couple non-urgent updates. And we want to build a community centered, primarily, around the podcast. 



Jeff needs someone to help keep things running, so it doesn't stall when he's not pushing everything. A lot is in place, already, but there are many things that need to be structured to remove Jeff from the company's systems and processes. 



We're not looking for a strategist to redesign our direction. We know where we're going. We need someone who makes sure our existing systems perform and can take ownership of building out new systems where needed (for example, the newsletter, our podcast guest pipeline, etc.), without constantly oversight or instruction, and eventually without daily check-ins or things falling apart and needing Jeff's attention. 



We don't need someone who is only good at one function, but wants to learn how to manage all the functions. If you're not already good at taking initiative and making things work with minimal input and oversight, then this won't be a good fit and you won't like the work you do with our law firm. But for someone who has built a law firm marketing system before, this will be a lot of fun. 



The Opportunity



This role is 20 hours per week with availability at least 4 days each week. Initial onboarding will include learning our systems and then building out a 90-day plan to take over full responsibility for as many marketing functions as possible, so the marketing can run without founder dependency.



As you prove yourself and the marketing works, the role will grow. We already have three podcast tea
mbers that you'll help to coordinate:



- Podcast & Content Manager: creative and publishing execution

- Podcast Editor: creates video and image content from the podcast

- Social Media and Blog Content Writer: junior-level writer for blogs and LinkedIn social media using podcast episodes



The right person in this role will transition into leading and managing both, and maybe growing the team so we're not hiring for where we are today. We're We're hiring for where we're going with both the law firm and the podcast.



Your Mission is to:

- Build clarity and structure across our marketing and podcast ecosystem

- Lead projects from idea to system to implementation

- Reduce founder dependency by creating reliable, documented processes

- Make the marketing engine run reliably, efficiently, and successfully



What You'll Own

- Newsletter: Launch it. Own it. It goes out on schedule every time, with content that reflects our firm's voice and is relevant to startup founders. You draft, edit, and send, or you manage that process end to end.

- Law Firm Blog: Consistent publication without us asking. You own the calendar, the coordination with writers, the quality review, and the publication. NOTE: we have the ability to produce a lot of content, but we need direction and implementation. 

- Podcast Guest Pipeline: We have a producer and editor , but we don't have. What we don't have is a system for finding, vetting, outreaching, and booking guests. You build that system and run it.

- CRM & Marketing Automation: Our podcast guest pipeline lives in GoHighLevel, and our law firm new client onboarding lives in a tech stack built around 
. You maintain them, improve them, and build new ones as we grow. You don't need us to explain what's broken. If you notice something, you can just fix it. And if we need to bring in someone to help out with complex issues, we can do that, too. 

- Website: Updates happen when they need to happen. You own access and make them without routing through us.

- Project Management: this is central to the role--make sure all the podcast and law firm marketing is organizing and getting done, filling in gaps and building systems and processes where it's needed or helpful. 

- Lead Pipeline: Inbound law firm leads come in through multiple channels. You track them, ensure follow-up happens, and maintain pipeline visibility so nothing falls between first contact and strategy call. We have a system, but it could be refined and improved.

- SOPs and Documentation: Every recurring process gets documented in clear, usable standard operating procedures. Nothing critical should live only in your head.

- Oversee community building: we will likely hire a community builder in the near future to focus exclusively on building out our podcast community (and possibly our law firm community, although that's a lower priority). You will manage that role, too, once we launch this initiative in the near future. 



Your first milestone will be a 90-day collaborative plan that helps transition from existing bottlenecks to you and the marketing team. Clear milestones and measurable outcomes will be critical.



Who You Are

- DISC: High S/C, Moderate D, Moderate I. You are steady, reliable, and process-oriented. You take initiative and drive results. You communicate clearly and can motivate others. You're comfortable leading both creative and technical people and thrive on making systems efficient and predictable.

- You take ownership, not instructions. When something is broken, you fix it. When something is missing, you build it. When something is behind, you address it, although not because we asked, but because it's yours.

- You're bothered by stalled systems. An unlaunched newsletter is not someone else's problem. A stalled guest pipeline is not waiting on a better week. These things are uncomfortable to you, and that discomfort drives action.

- You're a strong writer. Not a copywriter by trade, but someone who writes clearly, professionally, and in a voice that fits the audience. Our newsletter and blog reach startup founders and scaling CEOs making high-stakes decisions in businesses that are often doing $5-50MM or more. The writing needs to reflect that.

- You've done this before. Ideally for a law firm or professional services business. You've owned a marketing function, inherited something broken or absent, built it into something that ran without the founder's daily involvement, and you can tell us exactly what that looked like.

- You work independently. Async-first. Time zone flexible. Self-directed on priorities within the scope of your role. You produce without supervision and communicate proactively without being prompted.

- You can manage people. Giving clear direction to a contractor, reviewing their work critically, and having a direct conversation when something isn't right. This is normal to you, not uncomfortable.



What We're Not Looking For

- Someone who needs daily direction to know what to work on

- A specialist in one channel looking for a role that uses only that skill

- Someone who will build a beautiful system and then wait to be told to run it

- A strategist who wants to redesign our direction before executing anything

- Someone looking for a short-term contract or a stepping stone



The Application

Every candidate must submit two things before any interview will be scheduled.

1. A short video (3–5 minutes): Introduce yourself and describe a project where you turned a disorganized system or team into a smooth, reliable operation. Tell us what you inherited, what you built, and what it looked like when you were done. Also share your thinking on what the first 30 days in this role would look like.

2. A written response (400 words or fewer): Answer this question: Describe a marketing function you owned completely. What did it look like when you started, including what was broken, missing, or stalled? What did you build or change? What did it look like six months later? Be specific: name the function, the tools, the actions you took, and the measurable outcome. You can use AI if you want to, but if it looks like it was written by AI then you probably won't advance in the application process.



Please also include your availability, your desired hourly rate, and a brief note on why you're confident taking the lead on a new process without detailed instructions.



The schedule is flexible and mostly async, but you must be available at least 3x per week for regular check-in meetings. Over time, as we see things are working well, this will probably drop to 1x per week for quick check-ins



We are looking for someone to start immediately and want to establish a long-term partnership, not just a single project engagement.

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 400+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data entry role. You're the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate and flags problems before they cost us time and money. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don't let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with dispatchers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, logistics coordination, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems (a plus)

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: 7 AM – 5 PM CDT (San Antonio time) 

• Possible Shift (only if assigned): 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

This role works within clients' legacy ERP systems to manage accounts payable entry, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting tasks. The ideal candidate is highly accurate, comfortable learning multiple software systems and remote access tools, and communicates clearly in written English.

This is a remote position supporting a portfolio of clients, each with their own systems and processes. Adaptability and strong attention to detail are essential, as this role involves direct handling of client financial data.

Key Responsibilities

System Access

Core Accounting Tasks (within client ERP systems)

Communication

• Communicate in writing with U.S.-based clients as needed to clarify data, resolve discrepancies, or provide updates. (Note: this role does not require live client meetings.)

• Proactively flag any training or knowledge gaps to supervisors so they can be addressed quickly.

Qualifications

• Prior experience in data entry, bookkeeping, or accounts payable strongly preferred.

• Comfortable learning and navigating multiple software platforms and remote desktop tools.

• Excellent written English communication skills; able to write clearly and professionally to U.S. clients.

• Exceptional attention to detail — this role involves handling client financial data, and accuracy is non-negotiable.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple clients/systems simultaneously.

• Self-motivated with the ability to identify and communicate learning gaps or process questions.

• Familiarity with Financial Cents or similar practice management software is a plus, but not required.

Training & Development

• Onboarding: New hires will receive structured training to become familiar with our processes, tools, and client systems.

• SOPs & Resources: Written Standard Operating Procedures are available for reference, with a video training library currently in development.

What We're Looking For

Someone who takes ownership of accuracy, asks questions when unsure, and treats client financial data with the same care they would their own. This role is well-suited to a candidate who is coachable, communicates proactively, and thrives on precision and consistency.

This is a remote, outsourced position. Specific hours, compensation, and client assignments to be discussed during the interview process.

s, build the funnels, run the ads, and clean up the site, all in my voice, all aimed at the person searching for a way out of their pain. First you learn my world. Then you write from it.

s and run the campaigns. We

eting. That one is part of the job, not optional. It's where we stay on the same page and move the work.

title: Lead SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Specialist
description:
Lead SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Specialist



 



 About the Role



We are looking for a forward-thinking SEO expert who understands that the search landscape has fundamentally shifted. Traditional keyword-stuffing is dead; the future belongs to AI-driven search, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and agentic workflows.



At Dryscale, we partner with local home service companies to dominate their service areas. You will spearhead our clients' search visibility, ensuring they rank not just in the traditional organic results, but as the trusted, extracted sources in Google AI Overviews and LLM-driven platforms. You will work closely with the founding team (Nicholas and Jaxen) to ensure our search strategies directly translate into booked jobs.



 Core Responsibilities



* **Next-Gen AI SEO & GEO:** Adapt client strategies for the AI era. Optimize content structure, entities, and technical elements so our clients are the definitive answers recommended by Google's AI agents and other generative search models.

* **Local Search Dominance:** Execute elite Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization and manage high-authority local citations tailored specifically for the home service industry.

* **Strategic On-Page & Off-Page:** Conduct deep on-page SEO focused on topical authority and user intent, while building robust, high-quality backlink profiles.

* **Market & Pain Point Analysis:** Conduct deep market research to pinpoint the exact friction points and questions of our clients' customers, using this data to drive content and conversion strategies.

* **Site Architecture & Dev Guidance:** You won't be coding, but you will be the architect. Analyze current client sites and provide explicit, conversion-focused instructions to our dev team for site rebuilds and ongoing structural management.

* **Lead Capture Integration:** Ensure that the traffic you generate actually converts. Consult on and optimize lead capture systems to create a frictionless pipeline from search to sale.



 Who You Are



* **The AI Adopter:** You aren't stuck in 2022. You understand how Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) affects search, how agentic AI can take action for users, and how to format content for AI extraction.

* **The Local Expert:** You have proven experience ranking home service companies (e.g., HVAC, plumbing, landscaping) in highly competitive local markets.

* **The Clear Communicator:** You can translate complex SEO data into clear, actionable instructions for our dev team so they know exactly what to build, change, or add.

* **The Conversion Obsessive:** You know that search impressions mean nothing without a reliable lead capture system and a site built to convert.



HOW TO APPLY:

We are looking for a battle-tested Senior PPC Manager to take complete strategic ownership of our Google Ads MCC. This is a highly autonomous role. You will not be micromanaged, but you will be held accountable to hard performance data.



We need a true media buyer who can build complex, high-budget architectures from scratch, audit underperforming accounts, fix broken tracking structures via Google Tag Manager, and confidently communicate performance directly to our clients and leadership team.

What You Will Be Doing

Taking Complete Ownership: Auditing, architecting, and managing Google Ads campaigns (Search, PMax, Retargeting, Display) entirely from scratch.



Technical Troubleshooting: Setting up, testing, and fixing complex conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).



Budget Scaling: Safely scaling client budgets without blowing up their Cost-Per-Acquisition (CPA).



Strategic Auditing: Diagnosing stalling campaigns and identifying whether the bottleneck is the ad, the landing page, or the market.



Client Communication: Proactively communicating performance, wins, and strategic pivots to the internal team and directly to clients.



What You Won't Be Doing

Blindly applying Google Support Reps' "Auto-Recommendations" to artificially inflate optimization scores.



Following rigid call-center scripts or support SOPs.



Acting as a middleman between the client and an overseas fulfillment team—you are the fulfillment.



Must-Have Requirements

4+ years of hands-on, agency-side or in-house media buying experience. (Managing monthly budgets of $50k+).



Mastery of Google Ads Manager (MCC), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and GA4.



Proven ability to build single-theme ad groups, implement strict negative keyword lists, and connect offline CRM conversion data.



Excellent, fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) to confidently lead strategy updates.



A proactive, "fix-it-before-it-breaks" mindset.



???? IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: Experience working in an outsourced BPO environment (e.g., Concentrix, Teleperformance, TaskUs, TeleTech) as a Google Ads Support Representative, Customer Care Agent, or Account Strategist does NOT qualify for this role. We strictly require a hands-on, independent media buyer.



How to Apply

In your message, include a link to your updated resume and provide a brief (1-2 paragraph) answer to these three questions:



The "Google Rep" Scenario: Google Ads reps frequently call agencies pushing them to enable Auto-Apply Recommendations and Broad Match keywords. What is your philosophy on handling Google Rep recommendations, and why?

The Bad Data Scenario: You notice a client’s Google Ads dashboard shows 15 conversions this week, but the client
s you angry, saying their CRM only shows 2 new leads. What is your immediate technical troubleshooting process?

READ THIS FIRST



This is not a clip-and-caption gig, and it is not a slow, one-video-a-week role. This is a direct-response video editor seat inside a fast-moving, high-standards digital marketing agency. The volume is real, the standard is higher, and the work moves fast.

If you want to own the video output of a brand that is scaling hard, ship a high volume of organic content and
 ad creative, work directly with the founder, and grow into running a team, keep reading.



WHO WE ARE



We’re a digital marketing agency that works exclusively with exterior cleaning businesses (pressure washing, soft washing, window cleaning). We’re at $1.2M in revenue, 150 active clients, and retention sits at 98 to 99%. We built that by being obsessively good at one niche.



This role is not client work. You’d be editing our own brand: our YouTube channel, our shorts and reels, and the
 ad creative we run to grow the agency itself. We’re going hard on content and paid ads this year, and you’re the person who turns our raw recordings into everything we publish and everything we run.



The founder works directly with you, especially in the first few months. Real feedback on real edits, direction on style, and a fast loop so you ramp quickly. We want someone energized by that, not someone waiting for a finished playbook.



WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO



- Cut 4 long-form YouTube videos a month from batch recordings and client calls.



- Pull 3 to 6 shorts from each long-form for YouTube Shorts and
 Reels, roughly 12 to 24 a month.



- Build 
 to 
 ad creatives a month, including spinning up 15 to 20 variations of a single winning concept with different hooks, lengths, and CTAs.



- Export every asset in the correct format: 9:16 for shorts and reels, 1:1 and 4:5 for feed ads, 16:9 for long-form.



- Mine long recordings yourself (client calls, batch sessions) and find the best 
nts without being handed timestamps.



- Write and place on-screen text and captions that are clean, correctly spelled, and on-brand.



- Build motion graphics, animated captions, pattern interrupts, and sound design that hold attention.



- Keep raw and finished assets organized so nothing gets lost.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- Obsessive attention to detail. This is the number one trait, no exceptions. Captions spelled correctly, clean cuts, exports right the first time. If typos and sloppy text make it into your work, you will not last here.



- Real direct-response instinct. You know a hook has to land in the first three seconds, and you can build many strong versions of one idea instead of one and done.



- Generalist range across the major editors (Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut, Final Cut) plus real motion graphics, not just basic captions. We want the best, not the average.



- Written English strong enough to caption accurately and write and place English hooks. Spelling is not negotiable.



- High drive and self-direction. You move fast, you ship, and you don’t need to be told what to do every hour.



- Coachable on long-form. You may be stronger in short-form and ads, and that’s fine. We’ll build the long-form skill with you.



- Fluent with AI editing tools. You use them to move faster and produce more, as a multiplier, not a crutch.



WHO WILL NOT SUCCEED HERE



- Being honest because it saves us both time:



- People who let typos and sloppy captions slip through.

[About the Position]

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month
